description: This Kotlin source file defines the AlbumArtFetcher class, which loads and processes album art images for a media application. It includes methods for fetching, resizing, and normalizing bitmaps, and handles various configurations and scaling options.

classes.name: AlbumArtFetcher
classes.description: A class that fetches and processes album art images, resizing and normalizing bitmaps for display.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the album art image, returning a DrawableResult with the processed bitmap.

methods.name: normalizeBitmap
methods.description: Resizes and re-renders the bitmap to match the target size and configuration.

methods.name: isConfigValid
methods.description: Checks if the bitmap's configuration is compatible with the desired options.

methods.name: isSizeValid
methods.description: Determines if the bitmap's size matches the target size based on scaling options.
